notes: This directory is the authoritative stable Linx ISA 0.58 profile aligned to PTO ISA 0.58.0.
PTO-ISA/pto-spec is the sole normative source for 474 scalar forms, 99 command forms, and 109 tile operations; pto-spec.lock.json freezes its exact commit and tree.
Linx retains its additive two-level vector extension; PTO reserves its four vector block headers and complete 64-bit V.* root to prevent future conflicts.
TEPL uses separate Mode and Function fields as the unchanged encoding carrier for VEC and SFU; the legacy TileOpcode and all legacy decode aliases are forbidden.
BSTART.TEPL is the unique compiled carrier identity; BSTART.VEC and BSTART.SFU are accepted assembly aliases with engine-specific canonical output.
The exact tile inventory is 35 VEC, 52 SFU, 10 TLSU, and 12 CUBE operations. Unlisted selectors and unassigned functions trap as illegal instructions.

The exact semantic classes are 25 elementwise-tile-tile, 15 tile-scalar-and-immediate, 28 reduce-and-expand, 9 memory-and-data-movement, 12 matrix-and-matrix-vector, 7 layout-and-rearrangement, and 13 irregular-and-complex operations.
S0 through S255 are absolute-index shared tile registers in a core-private bank shared by the core's four PEs.
B.IOS names shared-register sources and destinations and carries the PE mask; B.IOT is Local-only, and mask zero is a NOP.
Deleted scalar and block spellings are assembler errors and do not retain v0.58 encoding reservations.
TLSU is the tile load/store encoding family; generic BSTART.TLSU is not a legal textual instruction, and each assigned function has an exact named form.
